en: The Hymn to Śrī Reṇukā
O Goddess whose feet are praised by Indra and the others, O Giver of Boons, O Fulfiller of Desires!
O infinite one, worshipped by Kāmadeva, O Mother Reṇukā, salutations be unto you! ||1||
In the beautiful Ekavīra, the self-supporting abode, which honors the virtuous.
O noble one, born from dust, O Reṇukā, mother, homage be to you! 2.
Her eyes were filled with the essence of compassion, and her face was graced with a beautiful smile.
O beautiful one, protect us; O fearless one, O Reṇukā, Mother, homage be to you! ||3||
O Vīramātā, Great Goddess, who else on earth besides you exists?
O Savior from the difficult passage, O Infinite One, O Reṇukā, Mother, homage be to you! ||4||
O Mother of Rāma, O Mahāmāyā, beloved of Jamadagni, O Fearless One!
O Victorious One, O you who are praised by the Vedas, O Reṇukā, Mother, homage be to you! ||5||
Those by whom your supreme feet have been worshipped are truly blessed in the highest station.
O Renukā, praised by the gods, you have been placed [in this state]; O Mother, salutations be to you! 6.
O Goddess, there is indeed no other supreme refuge than you, who belong to Śambhu.
O peaceful Reṇukā, who bestows both worldly enjoyment and liberation, O Mother, salutations be unto you! ||7||
And Maheśvara, Keśava, and Īśvara are also the agents of creation, preservation, and destruction.
O infinite one, O mother Reṇukā, it is solely through your grace; salutations be unto you! ||8||
O Mother of the Universe, salutations to you, O Renuka; protect us, O Sovereign of pure disposition!
May this hymn of praise be for your delight—O bestower of victory, gain, and glory, and giver of all aims! 9.
I know not how to invoke you, nor the procedure for your worship, nor do I possess devotion toward you, O Destroyer of Existence.
Moreover, O family deity, protect me, who am born into a family of devotees and am attached to wealth.
This is the supreme hymn of praise to the venerable Goddess who dwells in Mātāpura.
Whoever, being self-restrained, recites this with devotion, shall obtain all his desires. ||11||
